extracted.intended_audience: PhD students and candidates seeking paid help with proposals, dissertations, and academic publishing
extracted.subtask_description: Promotional/service page offering end-to-end dissertation writing and PhD research support, including proposal drafting, review-paper preparation, and guidance through journal publication to help publish in reputed journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-to-end dissertation writing and PhD research support
rubrics_metrics.description: Ondezx specializes in providing end-to-end dissertation writing and PhD research support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marketing claim that they provide comprehensive assistance across the dissertation lifecycle; no further procedural or quality standards provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research proposal writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Services ranging from research proposal writing...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offered as one of the service components; page does not list templates, structure, evaluation criteria, or methodological standards for proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review paper preparation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a provided service; no explicit guidance about literature search, synthesis, or review methodology is given on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Journal publication guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: We guide you through journal publication and help you publish research papers in reputed journals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims assistance with navigating publication processes and targeting 'reputed journals', but the page provides no specifics about journal selection criteria, submission standards, or ethical considerations.
